clips.title: The story
paras: Ironforge smith Tormus Deepforge seeks vengeance for his mentor, Sturgy Ironband, whose remote teaching outpost in eastern Dun Morogh fell to a sudden and bloody assault. The slaughter followed the arrival of a rare umbral ore shipment, which immediately drew the violent attention of the Dark Iron dwarves.

Sturgy Ironband was revered across Ironforge as an unmatched instructor of the smithing craft. From his secluded compound south of Helm's Bed Lake, he instructed promising pupils far from the crowded anvils of the Great Forge. That peaceful enterprise ended abruptly when one of his students acquired an unfamiliar mineral dubbed umbral ore. Intrigued by its properties, Ironband resolved to experiment with the sample, entirely unaware that possessing it had marked his school for ruin.

Shortly after the umbral ore reached the compound, hostile Dark Iron dwarves launched a ruthless surprise attack against the outpost. The assailants showed no mercy, slaughtering Sturgy Ironband and every apprentice under his care before occupying the grounds. Tormus Deepforge, one of Ironband's surviving proteges based in the capital, refuses to let the massacre stand, dispatching Alliance travelers to avenge his teacher and recover the cursed ore that brought destruction to the encampment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My mentor, Sturgy Ironband, had a compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. There he taught blacksmithing and he was the best.

But one day, one of his students brought him a load of strange ore. Master Ironband called it umbral ore and was eager to work with it, but soon after it arrived... A band of Dark Iron dwarves attacked his compound. They killed everyone!
Enter Ironband's compound, friend, and avenge my master's death. And bring me the load of umbral ore that caused it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you entered Ironband's Compound? Did you find the umbral ore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I hope you killed a host of Dark Iron dwarves while searching. I fear that Ironband's compound won't be the last place we see them.
But thank you for the ore, friend. I'm eager to work it and find its properties.
